facts.fact: Community health workers in the health districts of Diéma, Kita, Sikasso and Kignan reported births and perinatal deaths by smartphone into DHIS2 over eight months (729 live births, 35 perinatal deaths), via the DISK-Mali tool that the abstract says is integrated into DHIS2, per INSP and Vital Strategies.
Muso describes DHIS2 as the official national health data management system of Mali, and a DGSHP deputy director says interoperability between DHIS2 and DISC-Mali has been established.

note: Names only Mali's 2024-2028 digital health strategy; says nothing on an HMIS in service, linkage or reporting rate.

facts.fact: The IJRIAS abstract says DHIS2 is implemented in Mali for service delivery, monitoring and evaluation of health programmes, based on a survey run September 2023 to September 2024.
The study reports DHIS2 raised completeness and timeliness to 91.7%, from survey data on malaria and vaccination programme monitoring.
The source calls DHIS2 Mali's national health information system, to which community health centres, reference health centres and hospitals submit routine data.
Mali's Directorate of Pharmacy and Medicines states that the Ministry of Health and Social Development has retained DHIS2 as the national platform for managing health information.
Mali's Directorate of Pharmacy and Medicines reports that on 17-18 November 2026 it restored automatic data migration between DHIS2 and the separate OSPSANTE health-logistics system.
